# Content Hashing

The content_hash function provides a deterministic hash of a payload, ensuring that the content's identity can be consistently represented. This is achieved through the creation of canonical JSON and the application of the SHA-256 hashing algorithm. It serves to uniquely identify content in the context of the IR (Intermediate Representation) framework.
